summary: Iteration 8 backend testing: Catalog CRUD (grades/thicknesses/widths/lengths/mukadams/brokers), legacy mukadams/brokers shim, multi line-item inward/outward with summed theoretical weight & total pieces, backward-compat flat-field inward, entry_date persistence, variance aggregated across total theoretical weight, inventory + low-stock aggregation across line_items, FIFO auto-match on single-line outward. All 24 iter8 tests PASS. Full regression iter1..iter7 (including iter5) = 110/112 pass; the 2 failures are pre-existing data-pollution flakes already documented in iteration_5.json / iteration_6.json and are NOT caused by iter8 changes.

minor.issue: test_parties_sorted_deduplicated — pre-existing flaky test; prior-run data in DB breaks case-insensitive sort invariant. Not iter8 regression.

test_fifo_matches_oldest in iter7 suite uses a non-unique hard-coded grade 'FIFO-GRD-7'; older inwards from prior runs beat the newly created ones. Not iter8 regression — recommend parameterizing the grade with a unique suffix in the test.

action_items: None blocking. Backend iteration 8 is production-ready for the requested features.
Optional cleanup: iter7 FIFO test and iter3 parties test should randomize grade/party names per run to avoid DB-state flakes. Not an iter8 blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2099 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting (entries, catalog, analytics, email, pdf) into modules for maintainability.

catalog_<kind> collections are created lazily per request via db[f'catalog_{kind}']; no indexes created on them. Low volume so acceptable, but add indexes on _id (default) + unique on value if list grows.

In correct_entry() the stock-guardrail pipeline queries top-level pieces/thickness fields instead of line_items[*]. After iter8 migration all entries use line_items, so this guardrail may miscount in multi-line scenarios. Report-only; not covered by requested test matrix.
No pagination on GET /api/entries (defaults limit=200). Fine for current scale.
Catalog POST returns {'value': ...} without an 'ok' flag; consistent but idempotent duplicates return same 200 — correct per spec.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter8 (24/24); 98% on full regression (110/112, 2 pre-existing flakes)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* grades/brokers and unique-prefixed inventory specs (PYTEST_MULTI_*, FIFO_*, IT8-*) to avoid cross-test interference. These are leftover in DB but will not block subsequent runs due to unique uuid-based suffixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter8 feature file at /app/backend/tests/test_steeltrack_iter8_features.py covers all catalog + line_items + entry_date + variance + inventory aggregation + legacy shim scenarios. The 2 known-flaky tests (iter3 TestParties.test_parties_sorted_deduplicated, iter7 TestOutwardFIFO.test_fifo_matches_oldest) continue to fail intermittently due to prior-run DB state; main agent should randomize their test data in a future cleanup pass.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new bugs. Pre-existing flakes RCA: both tests assert against the FULL state of a shared collection (parties list / FIFO ordering) and don't scope by test-run uuid. First run of iter5 passed because DB was cleaner; later runs accumulate entries that break the invariants. Mitigation = parameterize test data per run (grade = f'FIFO-GRD-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4]}').
